title: The Delegation Blind Spot: Auditing Product Decisions from Agent Choices
abstract: arXiv:2609.26642v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Successful agent execution need not identify which future product improvement its user would value. We present a decision-specific audit that maps a declared observation channel and product-value contrast to compatible intervals and witness populations. Its foundations are established identification and decision theory; the contribution is an executable measurement workflow and a controlled study of its limits. A frozen experiment makes 4,800 requests to two pinned model snapshots on shared synthetic tasks. All 36 conservative primary intervals remain unresolved despite different execution accuracy. An exploratory 2,400-call follow-up records supplied preferences and resolves three of nine comparisons per model. A deterministic extractor resolves seven of nine without model calls or calibration observations, exposing unnecessary uncertainty introduced by model-generated reports. translated_title: 委托盲区：从智能体选择中审计产品决策
translated_abstract: 成功的智能体执行未必能识别出其用户会看重哪种未来的产品改进。我们提出了一种针对特定决策的审计方法，该方法将声明的观测通道和产品价值对比映射到兼容区间和见证总体。其理论基础是成熟的识别理论与决策理论；其贡献在于一个可执行的测量工作流以及对其局限性的受控研究。一项冻结实验在共享的合成任务上向两个固定的模型快照发出了4,800次请求。尽管执行准确率各不相同，所有36个保守的主要区间均未能得到解决。一项探索性的2,400次调用后续实验记录了所提供的偏好，并在每个模型下解决了九个比较中的三个。一个确定性提取器在无需模型调用或校准观测的情况下解决了九个比较中的七个，揭示了由模型生成的报告所引入的不必要的不确定性。进一步的14,400次受控多项式模拟区分了……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种决策审计方法，证明智能体执行成功并不等于能识别用户真正看重的产品改进方向，并通过大规模实验表明确定性提取器无需模型调用即可解决大部分偏好比较问题，从而揭示模型生成报告所引入的不必要不确定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-specific audit demonstrating that successful agent execution does not reveal which product improvements users would value, and shows through large-scale experiments that a deterministic extractor resolves most preference comparisons without model calls, exposing unnecessary uncertainty introduced by model-generated reports.
